definitions.explanation: Performances carried out in public spaces such as streets, parks, or plazas. Includes juggling, acrobatics, magic, music, mime, and other acts performed for passersby.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{大道芸|だいどうげい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw a street performance in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{大道芸|だいどうげい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やっている→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧がいた。
examples.english: There was someone doing a street performance in front of the station on the weekend.

examples.english: Every year this city holds a street performance festival, attracting performers from around the world.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {大道|だいどう} (main road, street) and ⟦{芸|げい}→芸：19343_gei⟧ (performance art). The performer is called ⟦{大道芸人|だいどうげいにん}→大道芸人：29758_daidougeinin⟧. Japan has a notable street performance culture, with events like the Shizuoka Daidougei World Cup being well known.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大道芸人|だいどうげいにん}→大道芸人：29758_daidougeinin⟧: street performer
- {大道芸|だいどうげい}⟦フェスティバル→フェスティバル：11703_fesutibaru⟧: street performance festival
- {大道芸|だいどうげい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{披露|ひろう}する→披露する：20927_hirousuru⟧: to showcase street performance
- {大道芸|だいどうげい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to watch street performance
